output.summary: The district is hiring the law firm Testan Law to defend it in workers' compensation cases, as needed, except cases about certain government code claims. The agreement is a memorandum of understanding (MOU) and engagement policy paired with a data sharing agreement. Payments are capped at $200,000 per fiscal year from April 10, 2025 through June 30, 2027.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $6,600 for Philanthropic Ventures Foundation workshops for after-school providers

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $6,600.00

output.summary: Philanthropic Ventures Foundation will lead four hands-on, two-hour workshops that introduce after-school providers to maker-centered learning, which has students build and create things. The board is ratifying (approving after the fact) the agreement for June 2 through June 4, 2025, up to $6,600.

output.headline: Proclaims May 6, 2025 as the district's Day of the Teacher
output.summary: The board is adopting a resolution that proclaims May 6, 2025 as the district's Day of the Teacher. The item states no cost.

output.headline: Extends Fremont Adult & Continuing Education's BankWork$ program agreement to 2028 at no cost
output.summary: This amendment extends the agreement under which Fremont Adult & Continuing Education provides its BankWork$ program through Oakland Adult and Career Education. The end date moves from June 30, 2025 to June 30, 2028, and the district pays nothing. All other terms stay the same.

output.headline: Pays Bay Area Community Resources up to $15,000 to hand off after-school lead agency role at three schools

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $15,000.00

output.summary: Bay Area Community Resources will follow transition steps and give the district's Expanded Learning Office the materials it needs as another group takes over the After School Lead Agency role at Frick United Academy of Language, Westlake Middle School and West Oakland Middle School. The agreement runs April 1 through June 30, 2025, up to $15,000.

output.headline: Pays Oakland Public Education Fund up to $42,000 to pay summer cluster lead stipends

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $42,000.00

output.summary: Oakland Public Education Fund will pay stipends to Summer Cluster Leads chosen by the district's Expanded Learning Office. The agreement runs May 1 through June 30, 2025, and the district will pay no more than $42,000.

output.headline: Pays Oakland Public Education Fund up to $110,000 for Oakland Tech summer internship stipends

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $110,000.00

output.summary: The district is paying Oakland Public Education Fund up to $110,000 to support stipends for students in the Exploring College Career and Community Options (ECCCO) summer internships at Oakland Technical High School. Students can complete the internships in person or virtually, and the work supports career and college readiness. The agreement runs June 1 through June 30, 2025.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $5,000 for Ball for Life Oakland to support PE participation at Oakland High

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $5,000.00

output.summary: Ball for Life Oakland LLC will lead inclusive games for a physical education class twice a week at Oakland High School, as extra support for students who are not currently dressing or taking part in PE. The board is ratifying (approving after the fact) the agreement for March 3 through May 29, 2025, up to $5,000.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $13,500 for Playworks' recess program at Fruitvale Elementary

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $13,500.00

output.summary: Playworks will provide its Recess Reboot program plan at Fruitvale Elementary School. The board is ratifying (approving after the fact) the agreement for January 31 through June 30, 2025, up to $13,500.

output.headline: Pays East Bay Consortium up to $27,500 for college and financial aid support at Madison Park

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $27,500.00

output.summary: East Bay Consortium will help eligible seniors at Madison Park Academy - Upper Campus apply for financial aid and postsecondary programs and graduate with clear next steps. Staff will work with students individually and in small groups. The agreement runs February 24 through May 30, 2025, up to $27,500.

output.headline: Accepts $34,320 Oakland Promise grant for a Castlemont High case manager's home visits

money.evidence: in the amount of $34,320.00

output.summary: The district is accepting a $34,320 grant from Oakland Promise under the Promise Neighborhoods program. The money pays overtime for a case manager at Castlemont High School who makes home visits and supports students' social-emotional health, violence prevention and attendance. It covers January 1 through December 31, 2025 (Year 1).
